expectations.text: Includes offline notes and automatic sync after connection returns without promising offline photos.
expectations.evidence: “Today we added offline notes”; “they'll sync after your connection returns. Photos still need a connection”.

expectations.text: Retains all-plan inclusion and no migration for existing notebooks.
expectations.evidence: “included on every plan. Your existing notebooks need no migration”.

expectations.text: Does not invent quotations, adoption numbers, performance measures, launch offers, or founder experiences beyond the supplied facts.
expectations.evidence: “Customers told us they were losing notes in basements” is sourced. “where Fieldnote was falling short” is a grounded characterization of that report; there are no invented quotes, metrics, offers or founder anecdotes.

expectations.text: 90–140 words; reads as a publishable post without assistant wrapper.
expectations.evidence: 105 whitespace-delimited words. Opens “Fieldnote now works for notes when your connection doesn't.” and contains only the publishable post.

review_method: Independent single blind agent review; not human feedback
